author: Haruko
name: BattleMetric
short: BattleMetrics, HLL RCON moderation, stats, TK watch, protection, VIP, and dog-tag review cog.
description: Modular Redbot cog for BattleMetrics server data, linked BattleMetrics and HLL: Vietnam RCON bans and unbans, authorized map changes, cached-rotation in-game next-map voting with scheduled and manual starts, periodic next-map verification and authorized live diagnostics, confirmed in-game admin promotion and demotion with configurable groups and group discovery, in-game messages, automatic private join notices with in-game player names and database counters, direct Discord replies to admin reports, kill feeds, automatic team-kill warnings with timed watches, forgiveness, and confirmed-offline case closure, role-pinging admin alerts, two-stage seeding that re-locks on population drops with configurable warning duration, HQ protection, timed and seeding-reward VIPs with BattleMetrics Seeder flags, VIP team switching, PostgreSQL statistics, account linking, and custom dog-tag review.
install_msg: BattleMetric loaded. Use [p]help battlemetric, [p]help serverinfo, [p]help killfeed, [p]help dogtag, /link, /vnstat, or /hllvn.
end_user_data_statement: Reads BattleMetrics, HLL RCON, PostgreSQL, and tagweb IPC secrets from Red's shared API-token storage; stores settings, authorized Discord user IDs, the in-game admin promotion group, map-vote settings, cached rotation, match timestamps, options, ballots keyed by game account ID, next-map verification state, admin-alert and team-kill-alert role and channel IDs, seeding, HQ-protection, and team-kill watch settings, warning/default deadlines and decisions, the VIP team-swap toggle, timed VIP records, team-kill alert and player-watch records, and pending dog-tag review metadata; temporarily queues in-game admin report text, authorized Discord admin reply text with message and author IDs and report targets, map-vote match/chat events and message targets/text with fingerprints and per-player cooldowns, and team-kill events in memory and tracks game player IDs, teams, positions, and death counters in memory for territory protection; stores account links and HLL statistics in PostgreSQL; stores staged or approved dog-tag PNGs in the configured host directory; sends moderation targets, messages, reasons, durations, and acting Discord administrator IDs and names to the configured external services; sends map-vote popups and game identifiers to HLL RCON and modifies the upcoming server map sequence; sends exact game identifiers and a group name to HLL RCON to grant or remove persistent server-side admin access, which is not revoked by Red user data deletion; sends exact game identifiers to BattleMetrics for seeding rewards and assigns persistent organization-owned Seeder flags there, which are not removed by VIP expiry or Red user data deletion; publicly displays in-game message targets and text in Discord command confirmations and the replying administrator in native admin-reply confirmations; stores a per-guild join-notice toggle and temporarily queues game IDs, player names, and connection-log fingerprints containing player details in memory; sends private welcome popups containing the in-game name and database combat counters to the joining game account through HLL RCON with private Discord previews for authorized tests; and retains player details and moderation decisions in team-kill alert embeds in their configured Discord channel after the buttons expire.
